name: web-tools
description: General web primitives the agent can call: web_search, web_fetch, and web_extract. web_search runs over the search provider you bind in Settings → Search, web_fetch is an SSRF-guarded page fetch + extraction, and web_extract does structured extraction. No key of its own — it uses the bound search provider's.
author: PersonalClaw

provider.label: Search, fetch and extract web pages
